trigger_condition: Canonical refresh replaces layout after pan/zoom.
guard_snippet: Preserve viewport across ordinary refresh and reveal retained focused nodes.
potential_consequence: Pan/zoom resets; a focused zoom-1 node can remain offscreen.
verified_evidence: GraphView memoizes model/layout by snapshot; GraphCanvas resets on layout and reveals only on zoom changes.

trigger_condition: External update arrives during pointer panning.
guard_snippet: Coordinate pan lifecycle with the shared interaction hold.
potential_consequence: A refresh can clear the active pointer gesture.
verified_evidence: Plain canvas focus is outside liveUpdatesHeld selectors; GraphCanvas does not use useLiveDrag.

trigger_condition: Keyboard traversal follows dependent/prerequisite edge rows.
potential_consequence: Table traversal differs from canvas node order.
verified_evidence: Declared prerequisite-first Tab order applies to the canvas. Table requires relationship/selection/filter parity, not the same edge-row focus order; GraphView.test.tsx:223 explicitly checks intended edge rows.

trigger_condition: Filter keeps a dependent but excludes its prerequisites.
guard_snippet: Show canonical prerequisites with outside-filter annotation.
potential_consequence: Depends-on cell can say None despite a real canonical edge.
verified_evidence: Rows derive only model.edges; model.requires and the separate relationship/blocker panel retain canonical edges. The local cell defect is confirmed; source data is intact.

trigger_condition: Capture response completes after Restore removes that capture.
guard_snippet: Fence capture completion or revalidate returned identity.
potential_consequence: Selection may reference an unavailable captured state.
verified_evidence: onSuccess selects returned ID after invalidation without epoch/membership check. This exact delayed mutation race was not reproduced; existing delayed comparison-read Restore tests are a different case.

guard_snippet: Reviewer requested a dedicated Retry action preserving selections.
potential_consequence: Recovery needs refetch/navigation/selection rather than a dedicated button.
verified_evidence: Errors are explicit and no stale comparison is rendered. Existing declared criteria require honest unavailable/error behavior, not this extra control; existing selection/refetch recovery remains available.

trigger_condition: Focused Retry succeeds and is removed.
guard_snippet: Recover focus to a surviving control if retry still owns it.
potential_consequence: Focus can fall to body while drawer stays open.
verified_evidence: Drawer open effect runs only on open; retry invokes provider refetch without focus ownership recovery.

guard_snippet: Recover focus when background reconciliation removes its owner.
potential_consequence: Focus can fall to body on feed replacement.
verified_evidence: Only acknowledgment markSeen schedules focus repair. Epoch reconciliation does not invoke it.

trigger_condition: Very large unseen history is drained and rendered.
guard_snippet: Benchmark high-event-count histories and bound presentation if required.
verified_evidence: All pages accumulate and ActorGroups remains mounted while hidden. No larger-history absolute budget failure was measured; current1000marked-Card acceptance passed.

guard_snippet: Capture readable endpoint identities in immutable Activity evidence.
potential_consequence: What changed can label endpoints only by UUID.
verified_evidence: Direct edge Activity contains IDs; activity-card-evidence.ts ownerCards emits IDs without titles; drawer falls back to identity. Markers and underlying edge identity remain correct.
